proposals.evidence: The Alu Kurumba tears word kāŋŋīru transparently joins eye and water. DEDR 1159(b) itself lists Tamil, Malayalam and Kannada kaṇ ṇīr 'tears'; DEDR 3690 gives the independent nīr 'water' family. Both ordered constituents are retained.
